sourceDefinitions.title: EIA international energy observations
sourceDefinitions.note: The connector requires EIA_API_KEY or EIA_DATA_URL plus EIA_SERIES_ID. It never converts an oil-flow baseline into a Qatar LNG volume.

sourceDefinitions.title: PortWatch route and chokepoint context
sourceDefinitions.note: PORTWATCH_DATA_URL must be an approved HTTPS machine-readable endpoint. The methodology page is not parsed as an observation; the reviewed Kpler route observation is carried when no machine-readable route response is available.

sourceDefinitions.title: Dutch TTF chart API
sourceDefinitions.note: TTF is market context only. It does not establish cargo availability, freight, insurance or executable substitution.

sourceDefinitions.title: Reviewed QatarEnergy force-majeure disclosure
sourceDefinitions.note: Automation may carry this reviewed claim but cannot fetch, reinterpret, or replace the approved event evidence.

sourceDefinitions.title: EIA Qatar LNG production series
sourceDefinitions.note: The configured EIA series ID is mandatory; the connector rejects a response that does not identify that exact series.

sourceDefinitions.title: EIA Qatar LNG export series
sourceDefinitions.note: An EIA production/export baseline is structural capacity context, not a current cargo or vessel observation.

sourceDefinitions.title: GEM Ras Laffan LNG terminal capacity
sourceDefinitions.note: GEM asset metadata identifies public terminal capacity; it does not prove current loading or operating utilization.

sourceDefinitions.title: GEM Ras Laffan LNG terminal status
sourceDefinitions.note: Asset status is a public registry relationship, not independent proof of current physical flow.

sourceDefinitions.title: UN/LOCODE Ras Laffan port identity
sourceDefinitions.note: UN/LOCODE supplies a stable place identifier and does not establish terminal throughput or cargo movement.

sourceDefinitions.title: PortWatch Hormuz route pressure
sourceDefinitions.note: The endpoint must return the exact Hormuz route and route-pressure metric; unrelated route observations are rejected.

sourceDefinitions.title: UN Comtrade Japan LNG import context
sourceDefinitions.note: Monthly customs trade context is explicitly labeled as demand context, never as live cargo movement.

sourceDefinitions.title: UN Comtrade South Korea LNG import context
sourceDefinitions.note: Monthly customs trade context is explicitly labeled as demand context, never as live cargo movement. Korea's Comtrade monthly series publishes with roughly an eight-month lag; the freshness window matches that reality (newest verified month: 2025-12 as of 2026-08).
